description: This file implements memory mapping functions for Windows, providing cross-platform compatibility for mmap and munmap functionality within the git project.

methods.name: void * git_mmap(void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
methods.description: Implements memory mapping on Windows, similar to POSIX mmap, with handling for file size and protection flags.

methods.name: int git_munmap(void * start,size_t length UNUSED)
methods.description: Unmaps a memory region previously mapped with git_mmap.

ctags.name: git_mmap
ctags.pattern: /^void *git_mmap(void *start, size_t length, int prot, int flags, int fd, off_t offset)$/
ctags.signature: (void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
